fusions.name: Nibbled Down
fusions.desc: Sends a grazing locust at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Warm Flank Rush
fusions.desc: The swarm surges round you as one herd, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every ally then strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Huddle of Wings
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. For 3 seconds after, you move 10% faster.

fusions.name: Slow Fattening
fusions.desc: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once, healing you for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
